Match colors, smash blocks, and clear the wood board in NO TIMER Block Color Mania!

Each vibrant block has its own shape and matching color gate. Your goal? Drag every piece to its color-coded exit. No filling rows - this is a challenging, precision-driven twist on the classic wood block puzzle, with no time limits and zero pressure. Relax and enjoy the challenge at your own pace!

With silky-smooth controls, bold visuals, and that oh-so-satisfying smash when a block hits its target, this game delivers a tactile, brain-tingling experience from the very first move.

# How to Play #
· Drag & Move the Color Blocks
Slide each uniquely shaped, colorful block across the board and guide it to the matching colored exit gate. 

· Match Colors to Smash
Once a block reaches the gate with the same color, BOOM - it's smashed! Each correct match clears space.

· Avoid Gridlock
Don't let the board get too crowded. Misplaced blocks can block paths for others, so plan your order carefully to prevent a full-blown block jam.

· Discover New Patterns & Obstacles
As you progress, new twists emerge: trickier block shapes, tighter grids, and unpredictable color layouts. Each level offers a fresh puzzle that pushes your reflexes and strategy to the next level.

# Game Features #
1. Wood Puzzle Feel, Fresh Gameplay
Classic wood block charm meets smooth movement and color logic.

2. No Time Limits, Just Relax & Play
There's no timer, so you can take your time and enjoy solving each puzzle without any pressure.

3. Color Match & Smash
Guide each block to its matching gate and smash it!

4. Tough but Fair
Levels get trickier with tighter grids and unique shapes.

5. Offline Gameplay
No Wi-Fi needed. Pure puzzle fun anytime, anywhere.

# What Makes It Different? #
· No Timer, No Stress
Enjoy a completely stress-free experience - without a timer, you can focus on the puzzle and make each move at your own pace.

· Slick, Responsive Controls
Feel every drag and release. With ultra-smooth mechanics, your decisions translate into instant, satisfying action.

· Polished Wood Aesthetic Meets Bold Colors
The perfect mix of calming wood textures and eye-catching color design keeps you visually engaged.

· Satisfying Clean-the-Board Goals
Deliver every block to its destination and leave no pieces behind. That full-clear moment? Unbeatable.

Ready to test your reflexes, logic, and color sense?
Block Color Mania is the fresh, relaxing twist on wood block jam puzzles you've been waiting for. Start playing now and smash your way to mastery!

Screw Block Escape: Slide, match, and clear the color blocks.

Screw Block Escape welcomes you to a bright color block jam where every move matters. Guide colorful blocks toward their matching gates, open the right path, and turn a crowded block puzzle into a satisfying block blast. The controls are simple, but finding the perfect order creates a rewarding block buster challenge for fans of puzzle games and brain games.

Easy to start, satisfying to master
Tap a block to move it in the direction of its arrow. Watch the board carefully, keep important spaces open, and build the right block escape route one step at a time.
The color sort mechanic makes each goal clear: every color block must reach a gate of the same color. As the levels progress, new obstacles, keys, locks, and narrow paths appear. The no timer adds excitement, while every successful solution ends with a smooth block crush moment.

A fresh board every time
No two layouts feel exactly the same, even with features such as timer or no-timer. Each color block jam introduces a new arrangement to read and a new sequence to discover. One piece may look ready to leave, but moving it too early can trap another behind it.
That is what makes every block puzzle feel rewarding. Bright brick-style pieces and clear arrows keep the board easy to understand, while polished movement and effects make every block blast feel crisp and satisfying.

Become a block buster
Early levels help you learn the rhythm naturally. Later challenges ask you to plan several moves ahead, protect each exit, and rethink your approach when the obvious route fails.
Use your block buster instincts to stay calm under the timer, avoid blocking key spaces, and create a clean block crush sequence. A difficult board may take several attempts, but the final solution always feels earned.

Why you’ll enjoy it
- Strategic color block jam gameplay with colorful levels
- Handcrafted block puzzle layouts that grow in difficulty
- Smooth block blast effects after a successful clear
- Challenging block buster objectives for strategy fans
- Relaxing color sort rules with meaningful decisions
- Bright and colorful brick pieces and polished 3D visuals
- Engaging brain games for quick or extended sessions
- Intuitive controls that are easy to learn

Players who enjoy puzzle games and the spatial thinking of tetris-style classics will find a different kind of challenge here—one built around directions, colors, timing, and route planning.

Your next route is waiting
Every color block jam has a solution. Read the arrows, test a path, and adjust your plan when the board changes. Whether you play for a quick break or stay for a tougher challenge, there is always another clever layout to solve.
Download Screw Block Escape today. Master every block puzzle, complete the perfect route, enjoy a colorful block blast, and discover how satisfying a smart solution can be!
